design_description: A sleek black-and-gold design centered around a luxury nightlife and techno-inspired identity. The jersey uses tonal vertical stripes with alternating matte textures and subtle herringbone-style detailing inside the darker panels, adding depth while maintaining a minimalist aesthetic. Thin gold trims on the collar and sleeve cuffs, combined with metallic gold typography and crest elements, reinforce the premium club-inspired atmosphere. Overall, the kit feels elegant, modern, and urban — blending classic football striping with high-end electronic music and streetwear influences.
